findings.title: Critical component is a single point of failure
findings.evidence: Single Web Server has one replica in eastus.
findings.recommendation: Add failure-domain redundancy and document the traffic or workload failover path.

findings.title: No health signal drives failover
findings.evidence: The component is critical but health_check is false.
findings.recommendation: Define an end-to-end health probe that validates dependencies and customer-serving behavior.

findings.title: Critical telemetry coverage is incomplete
findings.recommendation: Instrument golden signals, structured logs, and actionable alerts tied to the service objectives.

findings.title: Critical path depends on a single-instance service
findings.evidence: Single Web Server requires Single Database, which has no failure-domain redundancy.
findings.recommendation: Remove the dependency SPOF, add a degraded mode, or make the dependency redundant.
